policies.demo_reply: I'm sorry about the billing confusion. Please check your Spotify receipts and whether both bank entries are completed or one is pending. Another Premium account can also cause multiple charges. Keep payment details private.
policies.text: Spotify advises checking account receipts and bank payment status when multiple charges appear. A pending payment may be an authorization, and a failed payment followed by a retry can produce multiple entries. Another Premium account or a plan change may also explain charges. Account-specific review is needed to determine what happened.

policies.demo_reply: To cancel, open your Spotify account page, go to Manage your plan, and choose Cancel subscription. If a partner handles your billing, use its contact details on the account page. Please keep account details private.
policies.text: Premium can generally be canceled through Manage your plan on the account page. For a paid plan, access generally continues until the next billing date, followed by the free service. A zero-priced trial may end immediately. Partner-billed subscriptions require the partner contact shown in the account. Plan-manager and member actions differ.
